mapper.select: select subscription_id, user_id, capsule_name, subscription_status, billing_anchor_day, current_cycle_start_at, current_cycle_end_at, next_billing_at, expected_next_amount, paused_at, cancelled_at, created_at, updated_at from subscription where user_id = #{userId} order by created_at desc, subscription_id desc limit 1

select subscription_item_id, subscription_id, capsule_product_id, plan_version, item_status, coverage_amount_snapshot, monthly_price_snapshot, effective_start_at, effective_end_at, editable_after_at, created_at, updated_at from subscription_item where subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} and plan_version = 'CURRENT' order by subscription_item_id

select subscription_item_id, subscription_id, capsule_product_id, plan_version, item_status, coverage_amount_snapshot, monthly_price_snapshot, effective_start_at, effective_end_at, editable_after_at, created_at, updated_at from subscription_item where subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} and plan_version = 'NEXT' order by subscription_item_id

select subscription_id, user_id, capsule_name, subscription_status, billing_anchor_day, current_cycle_start_at, current_cycle_end_at, next_billing_at, expected_next_amount, paused_at, cancelled_at, created_at, updated_at from subscription where subscription_id = #{subscriptionId}

select subscription_item_id, subscription_id, capsule_product_id, plan_version, item_status, coverage_amount_snapshot, monthly_price_snapshot, effective_start_at, effective_end_at, editable_after_at, created_at, updated_at from subscription_item where subscription_item_id = #{subscriptionItemId} and plan_version = 'NEXT'
mapper.insert: insert into subscription_item ( subscription_id, capsule_product_id, plan_version, item_status, coverage_amount_snapshot, monthly_price_snapshot, created_at, updated_at ) select s.subscription_id, cp.capsule_product_id, 'NEXT', 'RESERVED_ADD', cp.coverage_amount, case when u.gender = 'F' then cp.monthly_price_female else cp.monthly_price_male end, now(), now() from subscription s join usr_user u on u.user_id = s.user_id cross join capsule_product cp where s.subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} and cp.capsule_product_id = #{capsuleProductId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from subscription_item where subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} and plan_version = 'NEXT' and item_status = 'RESERVED_ADD'
mapper.insert: insert into subscription ( user_id, capsule_name, subscription_status, billing_anchor_day, current_cycle_start_at, current_cycle_end_at, next_billing_at, expected_next_amount, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{userId}, #{capsuleName}, #{subscriptionStatus}, #{billingAnchorDay}, #{currentCycleStartAt}, #{currentCycleEndAt}, #{nextBillingAt}, 0, now(), now() )
mapper.update: update subscription set expected_next_amount = #{expectedAmount}, updated_at = now() where subscription_id = #{subscriptionId}
mapper.insert: insert into subscription_item ( subscription_id, capsule_product_id, plan_version, item_status, coverage_amount_snapshot, monthly_price_snapshot, effective_start_at, effective_end_at, created_at, updated_at ) select #{subscriptionId}, product_source_id, 'CURRENT', 'ACTIVE', 99999999, -- TODO: 실제 보장 금액 스냅샷 로직 필요 #{monthlyPriceSnapshot}, #{effectiveStartAt}, #{effectiveEndAt}, now(), now() from insurance.product_source where product_source_id = #{capsuleProductId}
mapper.select: select scs.capsule_snapshot_id, scs.subscription_id, scs.capsule_name, scs.created_at, scs.cycle_ended_at as next_billing_at, scs.total_premium as expected_next_amount from subscription_capsule_snapshot scs where scs.user_id = #{userId} order by scs.created_at desc limit 2

select distinct s.subscription_id, ps.coverage_category_code::text as coverage_category_code from subscription s join subscription_item si on si.subscription_id = s.subscription_id and si.plan_version = 'CURRENT' and si.item_status = 'ACTIVE' join insurance.product_source ps on ps.product_source_id = si.capsule_product_id where s.subscription_id in
#{subscriptionId}

select s.subscription_id, ps.product_source_id, ps.product_name, ps.company_name, ps.coverage_category_code::text as coverage_category_code, coalesce(si.monthly_price_snapshot, 0) as monthly_price, s.next_billing_at from subscription s join subscription_item si on si.subscription_id = s.subscription_id and si.plan_version = 'CURRENT' and si.item_status = 'ACTIVE' join insurance.product_source ps on ps.product_source_id = si.capsule_product_id where s.user_id = #{userId} and s.subscription_status = 'ACTIVE' order by s.next_billing_at asc, si.subscription_item_id asc limit 5

select s.subscription_id, s.user_id, s.capsule_name, s.next_billing_at from subscription s where s.subscription_status = 'ACTIVE' and s.next_billing_at is not null and s.next_billing_at <= #{now} order by s.next_billing_at asc
select count(*) > 0 from usr_payment_method upm where upm.user_id = #{userId} and upm.is_active = true

select upm.provider, upm.method_type, upm.masked_number, upm.is_active as active from usr_payment_method upm where upm.user_id = #{userId} and upm.is_active = true order by upm.updated_at desc, upm.payment_method_id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update subscription_item set plan_version = 'CURRENT', item_status = 'ACTIVE', effective_start_at = #{effectiveStartAt}, effective_end_at = #{effectiveEndAt}, updated_at = now() where subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} and plan_version = 'NEXT' and item_status = 'ACTIVE'

update subscription_item set effective_start_at = #{effectiveStartAt}, effective_end_at = #{effectiveEndAt}, updated_at = now() where subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} and plan_version = 'CURRENT' and item_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(monthly_price_snapshot), 0) from subscription_item where subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} and plan_version = 'CURRENT' and item_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: update subscription set current_cycle_start_at = #{currentCycleStartAt}, current_cycle_end_at = #{currentCycleEndAt}, next_billing_at = #{nextBillingAt}, expected_next_amount = #{expectedNextAmount}, updated_at = now() where subscription_id = #{subscriptionId}
mapper.insert: insert into subscription_capsule_snapshot ( subscription_id, user_id, capsule_name, total_premium, cycle_started_at, cycle_ended_at, created_at ) values ( #{subscriptionId}, #{userId}, #{capsuleName}, #{totalPremium}, #{cycleStartedAt}, #{cycleEndedAt}, now() )

insert into subscription_capsule_snapshot_item ( capsule_snapshot_id, product_source_id, product_name, company_name, coverage_category_code, monthly_price_snapshot, created_at ) select #{capsuleSnapshotId}, ps.product_source_id, ps.product_name, ps.company_name, ps.coverage_category_code, si.monthly_price_snapshot, now() from subscription_item si join insurance.product_source ps on ps.product_source_id = si.capsule_product_id where si.subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} and si.plan_version = 'CURRENT' and si.item_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: update usr_payment_method set is_active = false, updated_at = now() where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into usr_payment_method ( user_id, provider, method_type, masked_number, is_active, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{userId}, #{provider}, #{methodType}, #{maskedNumber}, true, now(), now() )
